summary: Austrian founder-run bending shop (25 staff, EUR 2-5 M). Owner prices from a two-year-old spreadsheet, second shift idle since spring, calls us an important reference customer. Holds 50 % of motor bracket HB at EUR 16.11, 3 % above Steinfelder's 15.63, and is qualified but unused on the coupling guard. Open deep; cite the rival price, check indices against its old spreadsheet, offer volume for price.
notes: Needs work for its idle shift; qualified on the coupling guard but at 0 % quota. Fears losing its bracket half to cheaper Steinfelder. Our spend is falling (-5.9 %). Amber scorecard (OTD 76 %), two open 8D, 21 complaints in 3 years. We pay 4.9 days late on average; no complaint.

evidence.quote: he works from his own spreadsheet, last updated two years ago.
they could take additional parts at short notice; the second shift has been on hold since spring.
Kantteile Strasser GmbH said Hollerau is an important reference customer for them.
45.9 % of invoices paid over 5 days late

arguments: rival price: sup:70340 supplies the same bracket at EUR 15.63
material/energy index vs its stale spreadsheet, only if the index fell
binding volume commitment to fill its idle shift
avoid: citing a cost driver that rose
tactics: Open deep at or below Steinfelder's EUR 15.63 and cite that price as the rival quote.
If current material indices fell, cite them: its spreadsheet is two years old.
Offer a higher bracket quota or coupling-guard trial volume against the price step.
Use the amber OTD and open 8D reports as a separate argument.
Expect 'a fair point' and keep moving in small steps.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; history: asked +3.6-3.7 % and settled 0, so it gives up its asks; owner-led with stale costing, expect generous moves.
